text: Options for the Computer Engineering (CE) elective lab (2022-2023) include the following courses: CE 4201 Electrical and Computer Engineering Laboratory in Computing Systems and Computer Engineering; CE 4202 Electrical and Computer Engineering Laboratory in Circuits; CE 4203 Electrical and Computer Engineering Laboratory in Signals and Systems; CE 4204 Electrical and Computer Engineering Laboratory in Devices; and CE 4205 Electrical and Computer Engineering Laboratory in Power Electronics and Energy Systems.
source_title: Options for Computer Engineering Elective Lab (2022-2023)
